authority.logical_unit: A single approved Starry Billing transaction authority for first-claim, receipt, entitlement CAS, and pending P05 business-core outbox in ONE durable commit boundary; not a guarantee of one physical D1 across all modules.
authority.single_writer: AI-2-owned server BillingAuthorityWriter called ONLY by authorized protected server services; no client/admin/SDK/AI-3 direct SQL/grant writer

separate_owners.p05_security: AI-0 + AI-3 issuer/verifier policy, AI-4 common DTO/SDK

rules: provider/store_namespace/ids derived only from independently official server-verified evidence, NEVER client-supplied receipt claims
first_claim lineage uniqueness does NOT include s_user_id; a new member cannot claim the same purchase
cross-app/brand/environment association must be checked before insert, not bypassed by introducing another scoped row
provider versions are separate incomparable domains; use provider-specific verified lineage and event ordering, not comparison between RevenueCat and Store counters
store_transaction_ref, provider_event_ref, original_transaction_ref names are abstract opaque verified references; representation, hashing/legal retention unresolved

ports.name: CurrentAuthFencePort
ports.trust: server-only signed current issuer+Session+member/app/env; client x-verified and user_id forbidden
ports.commit_boundary: MUST provide approved monotonic fencing / lock-with-authority strategy for revoke/write race; external independent Auth D1 read by itself cannot prove atomicity

ports.name: OfficialProviderEvidencePort
ports.trust: official Apple/Google server-side provider authority only; RC claims remain supplemental, NOT independent purchase proof
ports.commit_boundary: NO IMPLEMENTATION OR CALL AUTHORIZED IN W1

ports.name: BillingAuthorityWriterPort
ports.trust: server-only; no UI, Admin or unverified R007/R008 review object
ports.commit_boundary: ONE durable transaction: verify first-claim+source event uniqueness, upsert receipt, conditional entitlement revision, append P05 business-core outbox

ports.name: BillingPostCommitReadPort
ports.trust: authoritative same-store committed read; no read-replica/cache optimism
ports.commit_boundary: only after commit confirmation and current Auth fencing, never from in-memory candidate

ports.name: P05DeliveryPort
ports.trust: AI-3 verifies separate approved security envelope, current issuer/session policy and durable inbox
ports.commit_boundary: ACK only after receiver durable inbox commit; dispatch never inside buyer transaction and never grant by itself

ports.name: ProtectedBillingApiBoundary
ports.signature: future-approved protected route maps verified Auth, Store and writer ports; W1 has no registered endpoint
ports.trust: Route/Auth/App/Env scopes and status/errors must be approved; no arbitrary SQL admin gateway
ports.commit_boundary: default OFF, non-deployable in this proposal

writer_preconditions: D00 stage permits contract study only, not Billing live activation
valid server current AuthFence for same Starry member/app/environment; deny revoked/expired/deleted/guest and changed issuer/session versions
official provider verification AND approved App/SKU/ownership/lifecycle mapping; until G04 approved, ALWAYS DENY
no cross-brand, cross-environment, cross-app transfer, duplicate source event, same lineage double claim, unknown SKU or policy
entitlement expected_revision exact CAS; stale or missing expected revision is DENY
independent anti-PITR monotonic witness and cross-boundary current Auth lock semantics remain blocking until reviewed

proposed_tables.name: billing_original_lineage
proposed_tables.invariant: first claim immutable; verified original transaction binds exactly one owner; account transfer requires separate new approved process

proposed_tables.name: billing_source_event
proposed_tables.invariant: dedupe source, never accept client event as Store proof

proposed_tables.name: billing_entitlement
proposed_tables.invariant: revision monotonic and sealed negative transitions; no implicit restore after refund/revoke

proposed_tables.name: billing_p05_outbox
proposed_tables.invariant: business core and eligible receipt written atomically; security envelope later and separate

proposed_tables.name: billing_commit_receipt
proposed_tables.invariant: only committed authoritative rows exposed; no successful response after failed commit

transaction_protocol.action: REJECT untrusted R007/R008 review_only, provisional Auth, policy-unknown SKU, RC-only evidence
ACQUIRE current Auth fence + independently official verified Store evidence; validate app/env/member/issuer and monotonic authority
BEGIN approved single durable transaction within chosen logical authority (real storage primitive/migrations NOT yet authorized)
INSERT unique provider event and immutable lineage first claim; if duplicate identical -> replay/no grant; if conflicting owner -> hard DENY
CAS entitlement revision; apply only authorized state transition, enforce terminal refund/revoke and anti-PITR policy
INSERT receipt + D06 Layer-1 business core/outbox with conditional idempotency_key in SAME transaction; ensure event/source dedup
COMMIT, then read-after-commit from same authority; failure/ambiguous commit -> read unique receipt/commit_ref for reconciliation, NEVER blindly retry grant
AFTER COMMIT independent AI-3 delivery uses separately approved D06 Layer-2 security envelope; inbox durable commit-before-ACK, retry/DLQ
Revalidate Auth/issuer epoch and irreversible revoke before any externally visible entitlement (full atomic cross-domain fence unresolved; DO NOT enable live)

denial_matrix.case: unverified Apple/Google/RevenueCat or synthetic R007/8 claim
new s_user_id claiming same original lineage
same original lineage but wrong app/brand/env/sku
stale CAS revision or concurrent first claim
refund/revoke then restore/renewal or late active
auth revoked/deleted/issuer epoch rotated during process
transaction error after receipt before outbox
Queue send or ACK before durable inbox commit
PITR rollback resurrects previously revoked entitlement

p05.conditional_idempotency_key: required_when_payment_or_retry; ALWAYS for proposed Billing payment/refund/revoke/restore candidate events unless AI-0 approves per-type matrix
p05.emission: only persisted in billing_p05_outbox inside committed transaction; no network emission until separate approval
p05.layer2: separately versioned/signed/issuer/KID/replay fenced delivery structure owned by AI-0/AI-3/AI-4; no schema or signer declared final
mapping: event_id is the immutable outbox dedupe key
correlation_id ties authorized server request and eventual dispatch
idempotency_key is derived from approved business operation identity; not arbitrary client-supplied value
outbox commit_ref and receipt_ref are internal, NOT required core public fields
P05 13-column G06 requirement still unenumerated; do not guess 13th or replace with 17-field R006 offline candidate

G04 real Apple/Google/RevenueCat verification and test resources unapproved
G05 real D1/transactions/migrations and physical DB count unapproved
AI-1 Auth session fence atomicity across domains unresolved
